method: Same 12 annotated correspondences, source raster, initialization and priors. One fit optimized k1/k2; comparison disabled radial_distortion. Both are diagnostic fits and both fail configured acceptance.
interpretation: Radial refinement reduces RMS by 36.32 px (17.3%) but remains far above RMS/P95 thresholds 20/40 px. The large fitted radial terms, focal shifts, pose and principal-point changes cannot be accepted as lens-only correction. Geometry must not be changed from this fit.
